newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern concerned on rail merger.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern concerned on rail merger.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said it is concerned about implications that would arise from the the proposed $8.4 billion merger of CSX Corp and Conrail Inc.

"Norfolk Southern recognizes that the proposed merger of Conrail and CSX, if consummated, would have very significant implications for the nation's transportation system and for the shipping public. This combination raises serious concerns," the company said in a statement.
It said it will act "aggressively and responsibly" to protect interests of the shipping public, its shareholders and employees, and the communities that it serves.
"Whatever happens in this process initiated by our competitor, Norfolk Southern will be a part of it. We do not rule out any options," the company said.
